dct_description_sm: This principal layer contains polygon features that define the geographic boundaries assigned to each Kingston fire station. It includes attributes such as fire zone designation, station number, and area measurements in square kilometers. The dataset includes metadata fields capturing creation and last edit histories to maintain data integrity. Its polygon geometries facilitate visualizing and analyzing spatial coverage for emergency services.
